units.rawText: Professor, did you see our show just now? Hm? Judging by the look on your face, I guess you weren't really paying attention...
units.displayText: Professor, did you see our show just now? Hm? Judging by the look on your face, I guess you weren't really paying attention...

spans.text: Professor, did you see our show just now? Hm? Judging by the look on your face, I guess you weren't really paying attention...

units.rawText: I took in every move of yours, Vee.
units.displayText: I took in every move of yours, Vee.

spans.text: I took in every move of yours, Vee.

units.rawText: Oh? Really? Then what do you like best about me when I'm on stage, Professor?
units.displayText: Oh? Really? Then what do you like best about me when I'm on stage, Professor?

spans.text: Oh? Really? Then what do you like best about me when I'm on stage, Professor?

units.rawText: I like your smile, Vee. It moves the heart and lifts the spirit.
units.displayText: I like your smile, Vee. It moves the heart and lifts the spirit.

spans.text: I like your smile, Vee. It moves the heart and lifts the spirit.

units.rawText: Oh... Oh my, hearing that from you makes me blush...
units.displayText: Oh... Oh my, hearing that from you makes me blush...

spans.text: Oh... Oh my, hearing that from you makes me blush...

units.rawText: Your dance steps are full of life and their rhythm can sway the audience into following the music.
units.displayText: Your dance steps are full of life and their rhythm can sway the audience into following the music.

spans.text: Your dance steps are full of life and their rhythm can sway the audience into following the music.

units.rawText: My dance moves only improved because Nanaka "took care" of me during our previous practice sessions. If you like them, then all that suffering was worthwhile.
units.displayText: My dance moves only improved because Nanaka "took care" of me during our previous practice sessions. If you like them, then all that suffering was worthwhile.

spans.text: My dance moves only improved because Nanaka "took care" of me during our previous practice sessions. If you like them, then all that suffering was worthwhile.

units.rawText: Still, don't think that's all there is. I'll give you many more surprises, Professor.
units.displayText: Still, don't think that's all there is. I'll give you many more surprises, Professor.

spans.text: Still, don't think that's all there is. I'll give you many more surprises, Professor.

units.rawText: Yeah, I'll look forward to them.
